questions.title: Pizza toppings
questions.hint: Anything you'd put on a pizza.
rules: Anything commonly put on a pizza counts, cheese and sauce included.
Kinds of one topping count once: red onion and white onion are onion.
Named pizzas don't count: Margherita, Hawaiian.

questions.title: Countries
questions.hint: Any country in the world today.
rules: Any country that exists today counts.
Common short names count: USA, UK.
Cities, states and continents don't count.

questions.title: QU words
questions.prompt: Name a word that starts with QU
rules: Any real English word that starts with QU.
Forms of one word count once: the plural, and verb forms like -ed and -ing.
Names of people, places and brands don't count.
